title: The Long Furrow's quest text advertises three resolution branches ('Rest it (names, rite, verse), bargain it (a vow or raised stones), or burn it (Ironbound oil)'). After collecting all 3/3 'Names for the Rite' sources, Sister Merrow's Church rite, and Osk's own written verse, the cairn menu still only ever offered the two 'bargain' options (vow / raised stones) — the 'rest' branch the side-content built toward never appeared.
where: The Fallows / The Long Furrow — the Cairn
